topic: ARCH construction permit (Oct 2024) and project scope
wiki_text: On 8 October 2024, Ecuador's Agencia de Regulacion y Control de Hidrocarburos (ARCH) issued Resolution ARCH-DE-2024-0063-RES authorizing Pacificterminal S.A. (Pacific Terminal) to construct a maritime LNG import terminal at the Monteverde commune, Colonche parish, Santa Elena province (application filed 5 September 2024). The permitted works comprise an LNG unloading pier with an access ramp of approximately 630 m by 10 m, a maneuvering platform and mooring dolphins, onshore loading/unloading infrastructure, and regasification systems, with imported LNG stored aboard a floating storage (FSU) vessel; a roughly 100 km gas pipeline would connect Monteverde to Guayaquil. The resolution sets a five-year window to complete construction. The sponsor targets supply to the regional shrimp-farming industry plus cement, glass, plastics and thermoelectric plants. No regasification/import capacity figure has been publicly stated, and as of mid-2026 no physical groundbreaking, EPC award or FSU charter had been reported.

topic: LipiAndes acquisition of Sycar (2025) and operatorship
wiki_text: In 2025, regional energy group LipiAndes acquired a 70% stake in Ecuadorian gas developer Sycar (the entity holding Ecuador's authorization to import and market LNG/CNG), with the transaction announced operational on 26 June 2025; Sycar's remaining interest is held by its US affiliate Sycar LLC. Operational management of Sycar passed to Limagas Natural, LipiAndes' Peruvian natural-gas subsidiary. LipiAndes consolidates Lipigas and Evol (Chile), Limagas GLP and Limagas Natural (Peru), and Chilco (Colombia). Sycar has imported spot LNG into Ecuador (trucked/FSU distribution) since early 2022; the full-scale Jambeli FSRU import terminal at Bajo Alto (El Oro), long targeted for a 2025 start-up, remained without a confirmed groundbreaking.
